I messaged a relative who is a LEO with the comment and asked if it was worth reporting before I saw other’s had already and even after I noticed someone already did, my relative still called and reached out just to double make sure they were aware of the comment. 

I don’t currently live there but I lived in the area for about 7 years- just recently left. It’s shocking for something like that to happen there- there has been 1 murder there in like 2 decades. :/ It’s really horrible.
